segments.name: Waste management
segments.description: Singapore-based industrial waste collection, treatment and recycling business that turns hazardous and non-hazardous waste into circular products sold to industrial customers.
segments.evidence: ESA is a waste management, treatment and recycling company involved in the collection and recycling of hazardous and non-hazardous industrial waste from customers such as pharmaceutical, semiconductor, petrochemical and electroplating companies.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay ESA fees for waste collection and disposal, and buyers pay for circular products processed from the waste collected.
revenueModel.evidence: services income which is primarily comprised of the fees it charges its customers for waste collection and disposal services
